diagram_previews.alt: An oval made of two blue small arcs on the left and right and two red large arcs at top and bottom, inside a grey dashed 8 by 4 rectangle. The small arc's centre O1 has radius 1 to the right side; the top arc's centre O2 lies far below, with red dashed radius R to the top and to the tangency point T, which lies on the line O2 O1.
